# Overview

The **multi-species expression calls** endpoint retrieves expression call data
across multiple species, using homology-based similarity annotations to group
conditions.

It determines the Least Common Ancestor (LCA) taxon for the requested species
and returns expression calls mapped to multi-species anatomical entity and cell
type homology groups.

Homology groups are resolved by
[`AnatEntitySimilarityService.loadAnatEntitySimilaritiesRespectingNegations`](homology_resolution.qmd),
which handles both positive curator annotations and **negative** (non-homology)
annotations. See the dedicated
[Homology Resolution](homology_resolution.qmd) document for the full algorithm,
outcome paths, and worked examples.

**URL pattern:**

```
GET /bgee-webapp/?page=data&action=multispec_expr_calls&...
```

**Routing:** `page=data` + `action=multispec_expr_calls`
→ `FrontController` → `CommandData.processMultispecExprCallPage`

---

# Input Parameters

## Required

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `page` | Must be `data` | `page=data` |
| `action` | Must be `multispec_expr_calls` | `action=multispec_expr_calls` |
| `gene_list` | Newline-separated (`%0D%0A`) list of gene IDs. | `gene_list=ENSG00000170178%0D%0AENSMUSG00000001823%0D%0AENSDARG00000059263` |

## Optional

| Parameter | Default | Description | Values |
|-----------|---------|-------------|--------|
| `data_qual` | `BRONZE` | Minimum expression quality threshold | `BRONZE`, `SILVER`, `GOLD` |
| `data_type` | all types | Data type(s) to include | `AFFYMETRIX`, `EST`, `IN_SITU`, `RNA_SEQ`, `SC_RNA_SEQ` |
| `cond_param2` | all params | Condition parameter(s) to group by | `anat_entity`, `dev_stage`, `cell_type`, `sex`, `strain` |
| `anat_entity_id` | — | Anatomical entity ID(s) to filter by | UBERON IDs, or `SUMMARY` for summary terms |
| `cell_type_id` | — | Cell type ID(s) to filter by | CL IDs, or `SUMMARY` for summary terms |
| `limit` | 20 | Max number of results (max 10 000) | Integer |
| `offset` | 0 | Number of results to skip | Integer ≥ 0 |
| `get_results` | -- | Set to `1` to retrieve the actual expression call results | `get_results=1` |
| `get_result_count` | -- | Set to `1` to include total count in response | `1` |
| `get_column_definition` | -- | Set to `1` to include column metadata | `1` |
| `display_type` | -- | Output format | `json` |

Condition filtering uses only anatomical entity and cell type (`anat_entity_id`, `cell_type_id`, or `filter_anat_entity_id`). Dev stage, sex, and strain are not used for filtering. The magic value `SUMMARY` for `anat_entity_id` or `cell_type_id` expands to the same fixed list of summary terms as in the single-species expr_calls endpoint. Note that unrecognized parameter names are silently ignored, so a misspelled filter parameter results in an unfiltered (and much more expensive) query.

---

# Output Structure

## Top-level JSON envelope

```json
{
  "code": 200,
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "message": "Multi-species expression call page",
  "data": {
    "speciesByTaxon": { ... },
    "expressionData": { ... },
    "expressionCallCount": 42
  }
}
```

## `speciesByTaxon`

A recursive tree representing the taxonomic hierarchy of all species involved
in the query. Each node contains a `taxon` object, an optional `species` array
(leaf-level taxa), and an optional `children` array of sub-nodes.

```json
{
  "taxon": {
    "scientificName": "Euteleostomi",
    "level": 12,
    "lca": true,
    "id": 117571
  },
  "children": [
    {
      "taxon": {
        "scientificName": "Euarchontoglires",
        "level": 18,
        "lca": true,
        "id": 314146
      },
      "children": [
        {
          "taxon": { "scientificName": "Homo", "level": 28, "id": 9605 },
          "species": [
            { "id": 9606, "name": "human", "genus": "Homo",
              "speciesName": "sapiens", "preferredDisplayOrder": 1 }
          ]
        },
        {
          "taxon": { "scientificName": "Mus", "level": 28, "id": 10088 },
          "species": [
            { "id": 10090, "name": "house mouse", "genus": "Mus",
              "speciesName": "musculus", "preferredDisplayOrder": 2 }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "taxon": { "scientificName": "Danio", "level": 28, "id": 7954 },
      "species": [
        { "id": 7955, "name": "zebrafish", "genus": "Danio",
          "speciesName": "rerio", "preferredDisplayOrder": 3 }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## `expressionData`

```json
{
  "requestedConditionParameters": ["anat_entity", "dev_stage", ...],
  "requestedDataTypes": ["AFFYMETRIX", "RNA_SEQ", ...],
  "expressionCalls": [ ... ]
}
```

### Expression call object

Each element in `expressionCalls`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `gene` | Object | Gene info with nested `species` |
| `gene.geneId` | String | Ensembl gene ID |
| `gene.name` | String | Gene symbol |
| `gene.species` | Object | `{ id, name, genus, speciesName, preferredDisplayOrder }` |
| `gene.geneMappedToSameGeneIdCount` | Integer | Number of genes mapped to same ID |
| `multiSpeciesCondition` | Object | Homology-mapped condition |
| `multiSpeciesCondition.anatEntities` | Array | Anatomical entities `[{ id, name }]` |
| `multiSpeciesCondition.anatEntityTaxonScope` | Object | Taxon that scopes this homology group (`AnatEntitySimilarity.getHomologyScopeTaxon()`): `{ id, scientificName, level, lca }`. Distinguishes split homology groups that share the same UBERON term. |
| `multiSpeciesCondition.cellTypes` | Array | Cell types `[{ id, name }]` |
| `multiSpeciesCondition.cellTypeTaxonScope` | Object | Same homology-scope semantics as `anatEntityTaxonScope` for the cell-type similarity; `null` when `cellTypes` is empty |
| `expressionScore` | Object | `{ expressionScore, expressionScoreConfidence }` |
| `dataTypesWithData` | Object | Boolean per data type: `{ AFFYMETRIX, EST, IN_SITU, RNA_SEQ, SC_RNA_SEQ }` |
| `expressionState` | String | `"expressed"` or `"not_expressed"` |
| `expressionQuality` | String | `"gold"`, `"silver"`, or `"bronze"` |

**Example call:**

```json
{
  "gene": {
    "geneId": "ENSG00000170178",
    "name": "HOXD12",
    "species": { "id": 9606, "name": "human", "genus": "Homo",
                 "speciesName": "sapiens", "preferredDisplayOrder": 1 },
    "geneMappedToSameGeneIdCount": 1
  },
  "multiSpeciesCondition": {
    "anatEntities": [{ "id": "UBERON:0002101", "name": "limb" }],
    "anatEntityTaxonScope": {
      "id": 7776,
      "scientificName": "Gnathostomata",
      "level": 11,
      "lca": true
    },
    "cellTypes": [],
    "cellTypeTaxonScope": null
  },
  "expressionScore": {
    "expressionScore": "72.15",
    "expressionScoreConfidence": "high"
  },
  "dataTypesWithData": {
    "AFFYMETRIX": true, "EST": false, "IN_SITU": true,
    "SC_RNA_SEQ": false, "RNA_SEQ": true
  },
  "expressionState": "expressed",
  "expressionQuality": "gold"
}
```

# Request Flow

## Controller logic

The following flowchart describes the complete request processing in
`CommandData.processMultispecExprCallPage`.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 10
flowchart TD
    START([HTTP Request]) --> PARSE_GENES["Parse <b>gene_list</b> parameter"]

    PARSE_GENES --> CHECK_MIN{"gene_list<br/>size ≥ 2?"}
    CHECK_MIN -->|No| ERR1["❌ InvalidRequestException:<br/><i>At least two gene IDs required</i>"]
    CHECK_MIN -->|Yes| SEARCH["GeneService.searchGenesByIds(gene_list)"]

    SEARCH --> CHECK_SP{"Species count<br/>from resolved genes?"}
    CHECK_SP -->|0| ERR2["❌ InvalidRequestException:<br/><i>No genes from Bgee species</i>"]
    CHECK_SP -->|≥ 1| PARSE_PARAMS["Parse optional parameters:<br/><b>cond_param2</b>, <b>data_type</b>, <b>data_qual</b>"]

    PARSE_PARAMS --> CHECK_QUAL{"data_qual<br/>provided?"}
    CHECK_QUAL -->|Yes| VALIDATE_QUAL{"Valid SummaryQuality<br/>(BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD)?"}
    VALIDATE_QUAL -->|No| ERR4["❌ InvalidRequestException:<br/><i>Unrecognized data quality</i>"]
    VALIDATE_QUAL -->|Yes| COND_FILTER
    CHECK_QUAL -->|No| COND_FILTER["loadMultispecConditionFilter"]

    COND_FILTER --> NEED_DATA{"get_results OR<br/>get_result_count?"}
    NEED_DATA -->|No| SKIP_LOAD["Skip data loading"]
    NEED_DATA -->|Yes| JOB["Register & start Job"]

    JOB --> BUILD_FILTERS["Build GeneFilters<br/>(genes grouped by species)"]
    BUILD_FILTERS --> LCA["TaxonService.loadLeastCommonAncestor<br/>(all species IDs)"]
    LCA --> LOAD_LOADER["MultiSpeciesCallService<br/>.loadSimilarityCallLoader<br/>(SimilarityExpressionCallFilter)<br/>→ SimilarityExpressionCallLoader"]

    LOAD_LOADER --> CNT{"get_result_count?"}
    CNT -->|Yes| SET_COUNT["count = loader.loadDataCount()<br/>(cached per filter)"]
    CNT -->|No| RES
    SET_COUNT --> RES

    RES{"get_results?"}
    RES -->|Yes| VALIDATE_LIMIT{"limit ≤ 10 000?"}
    VALIDATE_LIMIT -->|No| ERR5["❌ InvalidRequestException:<br/><i>Cannot exceed 10 000 results</i>"]
    VALIDATE_LIMIT -->|Yes| PAGINATE["loader.loadData(offset, limit)<br/>(cached per filter+offset+limit)<br/>→ List&lt;SimilarityExpressionCall2&gt;"]
    PAGINATE --> JOB_DONE
    RES -->|No| JOB_DONE["job.completeWithSuccess()"]

    SKIP_LOAD --> TAXON_TREE

    JOB_DONE --> TAXON_TREE["TaxonTreeService.buildTaxonTreeWithSpecies<br/>(speciesIds, speciesById)<br/>→ TaxonWithSpecies hierarchy"]

    TAXON_TREE --> DISPLAY["DataDisplay.displayMultispecExprCallPage<br/>(speciesByTaxon, response, count)"]

    DISPLAY --> RESPONSE([JSON Response])

    style ERR1 fill:#f99,stroke:#c00
    style ERR2 fill:#f99,stroke:#c00
    style ERR4 fill:#f99,stroke:#c00
    style ERR5 fill:#f99,stroke:#c00
    style START fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
    style RESPONSE fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
```

## Service layer

The endpoint delegates to several model-layer services. Two are central to the multi-species flow:

### `TaxonTreeService.buildTaxonTreeWithSpecies`

`TaxonTreeService` is a dedicated service that builds the `speciesByTaxon` hierarchy. It exists as a separate service (rather than extending `TaxonService` or `OntologyService`) because it combines ontology structure with species data to produce a tree-shaped display model: `TaxonService` focuses on retrieving individual taxa; `OntologyService` returns graph structures. `TaxonTreeService` bridges these to produce the recursive `TaxonWithSpecies` tree used in the API response.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 8
flowchart TD
    A["OntologyService.getTaxonOntologyLeadingToSpecies<br/>(speciesIds, withLCA=true)"] --> B["Build speciesByParentTaxonId map<br/>(Species.getParentTaxonId → List&lt;Species&gt;)"]
    B --> C["For each Taxon in ontology:<br/>find all ancestors"]
    C --> D{"ancestors<br/>empty?"}
    D -->|Yes| ROOT["Mark as root"]
    D -->|No| PARENT["Parent = ancestor with<br/>highest taxonomic level<br/>(closest to leaves)"]
    PARENT --> MAP["Add to childrenByParent map"]
    MAP --> C
    ROOT --> BUILD["buildTaxonNode(root,<br/>childrenByParent,<br/>speciesByParentTaxonId)"]
    BUILD --> RECURSE["For each child taxon:<br/>recurse buildTaxonNode"]
    RECURSE --> NODE["TaxonWithSpecies {<br/>  taxon,<br/>  species (from parentTaxonId),<br/>  children (recursive)<br/>}"]

    style ROOT fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#e65100
    style NODE fill:#e3f2fd,stroke:#1565c0
```

### `MultiSpeciesCallService.loadSimilarityCallLoader` / `SimilarityExpressionCallLoader`

The controller builds a `SimilarityExpressionCallFilter` (a `CallFilter` subclass accepting
multiple `GeneFilter`s, the taxon ID, and the `onlyTrusted` flag) and obtains a
`SimilarityExpressionCallLoader` via `loadSimilarityCallLoader`. The loader exposes
`loadData(offset, limit)` and `loadDataCount()`, mirroring `ExpressionCallLoader`. The
aggregation below is performed once per loader and memoized, so paging and counting within a
request do not re-scan the data source. (The stream-returning `loadSimilarityExpressionCalls2`
remains as a convenience wrapper over the loader.)

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 10
flowchart TD
    ENTRY["loadSimilarityCallLoader(filter)<br/>→ prepared filter +<br/>SimilarityExpressionCallLoader"]
    ENTRY --> ANNOT["AnatEntitySimilarityService<br/>.loadAnatEntitySimilaritiesRespectingNegations<br/>(taxonId, onlyTrusted)"]
    ANNOT --> AE_GROUPS["Extract anatEntity groups &<br/>cellType groups from<br/>similarity annotations"]

    AE_GROUPS --> PER_SPECIES["For each species in geneFilters:"]
    PER_SPECIES --> BUILD_CF["Build ExpressionCallFilter2 with:<br/>• summaryQuality (param)<br/>• GeneFilter (per species)<br/>• ConditionFilter2 (anat/cell groups)<br/>• DataType filter"]
    BUILD_CF --> LOAD_EC["ExpressionCallService.loadCallLoader()<br/>→ ExpressionCallLoader.loadData()<br/>(ExpressionCall2, attributes incl. DATA_QUALITY)"]
    LOAD_EC --> COLLECT_EC["Collect ExpressionCall2 list per species"]

    COLLECT_EC --> GROUP["Group calls by<br/>MultiSpeciesCondition<br/>(similarity-mapped anat entities)"]
    GROUP --> ASSEMBLE["Assemble SimilarityExpressionCall2:<br/>gene + multiSpeciesCondition +<br/>calls with quality"]

    ASSEMBLE --> STREAM["loader.loadData(offset, limit) /<br/>loadDataCount()"]

    style ENTRY fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
    style STREAM fill:#e3f2fd,stroke:#1565c0
```

## JSON serialization: `MultispecExprCallResponseTypeAdapter`

`SimilarityExpressionCall2`s are serialized directly by
`MultispecExprCallResponseTypeAdapter` (no intermediate DTO). For each call, the adapter
derives the `expressionScore`, `expressionScoreConfidence`, `dataTypesWithData`,
`expressionState`, and `expressionQuality` fields from the underlying `ExpressionCall2`s.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 8
flowchart TD
    SC["SimilarityExpressionCall2"] --> GENE["Extract Gene"]
    SC --> MSC["Extract MultiSpeciesCondition<br/>(anatEntities, cellTypes)"]
    SC --> CALLS["Get underlying ExpressionCall2 list"]

    CALLS --> LCA["Compute species LCA<br/>from call species IDs"]
    CALLS --> SCORE["Find max expressionScore<br/>across all calls"]
    CALLS --> DT["Collect DataTypes with data<br/>(from callData)"]
    CALLS --> QUAL["Get first non-null<br/>SummaryQuality"]

    DT --> CONF{"Has AFFYMETRIX,<br/>RNA_SEQ, or SC_RNA_SEQ,<br/>or score < 20000?"}
    CONF -->|Yes| HIGH["confidence = 'high'"]
    CONF -->|No| LOW["confidence = 'low'"]

    GENE --> ITEM
    MSC --> ITEM
    LCA --> ITEM
    SCORE --> ITEM
    HIGH --> ITEM
    LOW --> ITEM
    DT --> ITEM
    QUAL --> ITEM["JSON call object<br/>(written by type adapter)"]

    style SC fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#e65100
    style ITEM fill:#e3f2fd,stroke:#1565c0
```

# Example Request

```
http://localhost:8080/bgee-webapp/?page=data
  &action=multispec_expr_calls
  &display_type=json
  &get_results=1
  &limit=10000
  &gene_list=ENSDARG00000059263%0D%0AENSG00000170178%0D%0AENSMUSG00000001823
  &data_qual=SILVER
```

This requests multi-species expression calls for three genes (zebrafish
`hoxd12a`, human `HOXD12`, mouse `Hoxd12`) with a minimum quality of SILVER.
